item.question: How do different estimation algorithms perform under no-excitation conditions in power networks?
item.answer: Under no-excitation conditions, the VDF-RLS algorithm maintains accuracy better than others. The Kalman filter and CF-RLS become highly sensitive to measurement noise, resulting in significantly higher RMSPE values compared to VDF-RLS. RLS without forgetting fails to adapt well.
